card.name: The after advise/alert about, before risk or need
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "these") right after "of", "about" or "because of" in counseling sentences. It comes before a noun like "risk" or "need" in warnings to patients, families or prescribers.

modes.label: Counseling about a risk
modes.description: "the" after "advise ... of" or "alerted about", introducing a risk or need to monitor.

modes.label: Because of these risks
modes.description: "these" after "Because of" leading into a restriction on prescribing.
modes.example: Because of<< these>> risks, reserve concomitant prescribing of
